stem.text: The graph shows the results of two experiments on the effect of increasing substrate concentration on the rate of an enzyme-catalysed reaction.
One experiment was at a high concentration of enzyme and the second was at a low concentration of enzyme.

stem.alt: Graph of initial rate of reaction against substrate concentration, with a dashed curve labelled high enzyme concentration and a solid curve labelled low enzyme concentration, and a point marked X on the solid curve.

stem.text: What would limit the initial rate of reaction at point X?
